title: Reports
subtitle: Branch collection trends, reconciliation with the ERP and file downloads.

trends.collectedHelp: Money recorded in the staff app, not the ERP ledger
trends.chartSub: Click a bar to open that day's collections
trends.chartSubWeek: Each bar is one week starting on Saturday
trends.overdueSub: ERP figures as of {{date}}. Not an official balance.
trends.noOverdue: No overdue snapshot has been stored for this period yet

recon.fosPosted: Field collections posted to the ERP
recon.erpNone: The ERP reported no field payment for this day
recon.gap: Gap between posted field collections and the ERP

exports.intro: A file takes about a minute to build. It is kept for 7 days and only you can see it.
exports.noPermission: You do not have permission to download files.
exports.scope: The file covers the branch that is selected now.

errors.order: The start date cannot be after the end date
errors.future: A future date is not allowed
errors.tooLong: This data allows at most {{n}} days

exports.jobsEmpty: You have not built a file yet
exports.linkNote: A download link works for 5 minutes
exports.pdfHelp: A4 landscape with Bangla. For exactly what a page shows, use PDF / Print on that page.

pdf.title: Print a page as PDF
pdf.how: Open the report, press 'PDF / Print' at the top, then choose 'Save as PDF' in the print dialog. Bangla conjuncts come out right.

dq.title: Data quality
dq.subtitle: Customers whose location, phone, plan or assignment is missing or wrong. Fix them in the ERP or here, then they drop off the list.
dq.printNote: Only the page shown on screen is printed. Use Downloads for the full list.

no_location.label: No location
no_location.help: The ERP has no coordinates, so the customer is not on the map.

suspect_swapped.label: Latitude and longitude swapped
suspect_swapped.help: The two numbers look the wrong way round.

far_from_branch.label: Far from the branch
far_from_branch.help: The pin is more than {{km}} km from the branch.

missing_phone.label: No phone number
missing_phone.help: Staff cannot call before a visit.

shared_phone.label: Phone shared with others
shared_phone.help: The same number belongs to another customer of the branch.

plan_without_schedule.label: Plan without installments
plan_without_schedule.help: An open plan has no installment schedule, so nothing is ever due.

unassigned.label: No staff assigned
unassigned.help: Nobody is responsible for visiting this customer.

fix.location: Fix: correct the coordinates in the ERP, or approve a pin from the field.
fix.phone: Fix: correct the phone number in the ERP.
fix.plan: Fix: add the installment schedule in the ERP.
fix.assignment: Fix: assign the customer from Areas.

lb.title: Leaderboard
lb.subtitle: Field staff of the branch ranked by one measure. Equal values share a rank.
lb.empty: No field staff to rank in this period
lb.unranked: Staff with fewer than {{n}} days present are listed without a rank.
lb.unrankedTarget: Staff with fewer than {{n}} days present, or without a target, are listed without a rank.

how.collected: Money recorded in the field, not voided or refunded. Not the ERP ledger.
how.visit_credit: Single visits count 1; a joint visit counts the share set in Co-work settings.
how.promises_kept: Promises due in this period that the customer kept.
how.target_achievement: Collected divided by the target for the working days so far.
